domain: NAV COUNTERS + DATA STATE / PROVENANCE PANEL + NOTIFICATIONS
summary: Today the chrome of the portal — left nav counts, the sidebar "today" box, the 8 radar KPI cards, the 20-tile region map, the 7 source tiles, the transparency ("DEMO ENVIRONMENT") panel and the notification bell — is almost entirely fed by one object, `D.KPI` (aliased `K` at portale.html:2549), plus `D.WINDOW_KPI`, `D.FIELD_KPI`, `D.REGION_STATS`, `D.WHAT_CHANGED` and `D.NOTIFICATIONS`. Those are computed inside italy-demo-data.js from the demo fixtures (29 demo CASES, 72 demo ACTIVITIES, 56 demo SIGNALS, 53 demo SOURCES, 448-row demo ARCHIVE, 36 demo RECORDS, 39 demo PEOPLE), so every badge is a fixture number even when a real one exists. Measured, the gap is large and always in the same direction: competitors nav says 72, real is 503; science says 36, real is 88; archive says 448, real is 740; sources says 92, real is 31; "competitor movements · 30d" says 43, real is 11; the transparency panel claims 244 real / 491 demo when the real application model holds 1038 real / 100 demo records. Four numbers are honest by luck (29 windows, 6 window-open, 2 next-cycle, 5 date-unknown) because the demo CASES are a 1:1 shadow of the 29 canonical windows. The transparency panel itself is the worst offender in principle: it is the screen that promises to tell the truth about the data, and it reads the fixture (`D.ACTIVITIES`, `D.ARCHIVE`, `D.FIELD_MESSAGES`) to do it. `D.NOTIFICATIONS` is six hand-written alerts asserting field messages, window countdowns and a BASF movement that exist nowhere in the ingested data.
realSource: APP = window.ITALY_APP_MODEL. Nav and KPI counts come from APP.counts / APP.collections (windows 29 · competitorActivities 503 · scienceRecords 88 · archive 740 · sources 31 · researchers 60 · voices 17 · products 166 · marketObservations 77 · resistance 34 · channels 30 · events 18 · news 8 · futureSignals 3 · upstreamOpportunities 3). Window status buckets come from APP.collections.windows.records[].status (upstream CURRENT_STATUS). Verified portfolio matches come from window.ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS (VERIFIED 12 / NOT_FOUND 7) — which italy-app-model.js does NOT read yet. Regulatory use rows come from IG.LINKS (219). Source-group tiles come from IG.SOURCES[].TYPE (31 records). The transparency panel comes from APP.provenanceSummary. Field Sales KPIs stay on D.FIELD_MESSAGES as an explicitly labelled optional-integration demo (§5).

risks: The screen loses roughly 70% of its content. Measured honestly: the radar goes from 29 cards to 3, and the detail page loses the evidence bars, the competitor panel, the action map, the executive timeline, the field inbox, the adjacency map shading, the latin name, the origin tile and the label-timing line. What remains — title, what is happening with a named document and date, why it matters, what we know, what we do not know, interpretations, sources — is genuinely strong content, but it is one column where there were three. The client must be told BEFORE the edit, not after, and §3 forbids redesigning the screen to fill the hole.

The three real records are written in PORTUGUESE, and §11 makes Italian the default language. TITLE, CROP, ISSUE, CURRENT_EVIDENCE, WHAT_WE_KNOW, WHAT_WE_DO_NOT_KNOW and INTERPRETATIONS are all pt-BR ('Videira', 'Milho grao', 'a obrigacao de tratar o vetor e norma, nao recomendacao'). The regulatory quotes inside them are Italian. This is not a translation the engineer may perform — translating a source record is exactly the fact-mutation the product law forbids, and product/company/Latin names must not be touched at all. Either upstream reissues the records in Italian, or the portal ships with visibly Portuguese body text on its three real cards. Flag to the data owner before STEP 2.

ISSUE_TYPE on opp 003 is the literal string 'NAO SEI' ('I do not know'). The same literal appears across the real data: VOICES.REGION is 'NAO SEI' 17/17, NEWS.REGION 8/8, FUTURE_SIGNALS.REGION 2/3. Any code path that renders a raw field will print 'NAO SEI' to an Italian user. Every new binding needs an explicit guard mapping it to t.notKnown.

Four incompatible crop vocabularies coexist in the real data and the synonym table is load-bearing. Measured: OPPORTUNITIES.CROP is Portuguese; CANONICAL.CROP_NAME and D.CASES.crop are English; COMP_ACTIVITIES.crops is Latin/Italian ('Vitis vinifera' 42, 'Zea mays' 67, 'colture' 59, 'cereali' 24); VOICES.CROP and SCIENCE.CROP are SCREAMING_SNAKE ('VINE' 45, 'MAIZE' 8, 'DURUM_WHEAT' 40). If the table is wrong the detail page will show competitor and science cross-links belonging to the wrong crop — a silent wrong answer, worse than an empty panel. Build it as one reviewed literal and default to empty, never to a fuzzy match.

There is a FIFTH id space for cases. VOICES.CASE_ID measures as IT-VINE-FLAVESCENCE (8 voices), IT-MAIZE-WEED (8) and IT-DURUM_WHEAT-FUSARIUM (1). Only the first corresponds to a real opportunity. So if the detail page adds a field-voices panel, opp 001 gets 8 voices and opp 002 and 003 get zero — and the 8 MAIZE voices are about WEEDS, not the piralide that opp 002 is about. Do not join maize to maize.

Treating them as the radar's real feed instead of the 3 opportunities would produce a denser and more comfortable screen that still cannot answer 'who published this'.
